name: lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa_xip_thunk

ownership.argument: Borrowed live LVGL object in r0, opacity in r1 and style selector in r2. Resource Hook changes only the validated control-center container with selector zero.
ownership.return_value: No ownership transfer and no success-code ABI. Setter may allocate a native local style and synchronously refresh layout/style.

provenance.source: Exact .043 AP bytes, startup-copy map, IDA target body and native CC creation call sites. Eight-byte XIP thunk jumps to 0x002be508, which forwards property 29 to the native local-style setter.

notes: Exact Resource Hook control-center identity only. Audited ABI: void(void *obj, uint32_t opacity, uint32_t selector). No prototype field or new callable wrapper is exported. Existing lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa canonical record is retained. Restricted STATIC_RECOVERED/PENDING, device not_probed. No additional target, address range or transitive callee is authorized.
